fact: The public procurement regulator ARMP states it has designed, developed and deployed its Pridesoft procurement platform since 2014 and on 19 February 2025 called for five developers and a statistician to continue developing the system.
title: Appel à candidatures N° 00016/AC/ARMP/2025 du 19 février 2025 relatif au recrutement de cinq développeurs et un statisticien à l'Agence de Régulation des Marchés Publics
publisher: Agence de Régulation des Marchés Publics
